Can one customer have more than one orde: Yes, a customer can have many orders, and each order is separate.
What happens if someone pays more deposi: That must be refused. Paying the full price as the deposit is fine.
Does 'due on or before' include orders d: Yes, orders due on that day are included.
Should collected orders still appear in: Yes, the customer's list shows all their orders. Only the due list leaves out collected ones.
Do measurements change for each order?: No, measurements are kept on the customer.
